Thanks — invite is sent (link below). I attached a 1-page summary with bullet talking points that map to your asks:
- Reconciliation: typical end-to-end processing latency 2–5s per batch (depends on PSP response), we use stream-ack and idempotent writes to ensure no double-processing.
- Refund/edge-case flow: we keep an immutable event log and maintain a compensating job that replays idempotent ops; we can share sample logs if needed.
- SLA/retention: options for 90/180/365 day encrypted retention with audit trail export; we can support export on audit windows.
